subject: regional-punjabi
title: Punjabi — Set 2
description: Common phrases, nature, and everyday words

questions.question: What does 'ਕਿਤਾਬ' (Kitab) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ਕਿਤਾਬ' means book in Punjabi. It comes from the Urdu/Persian 'kitab'.

questions.question: What does 'ਸੂਰਜ' (Suraj) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ਸੂਰਜ' means Sun in Punjabi. It is related to Sanskrit 'ਸੂਰ੍ਯ'.

questions.question: What does 'ਮੀਂਹ' (Meenh) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ਮੀਂਹ' means rain in Punjabi. Punjab (Land of Five Rivers) depends heavily on seasonal rain.

questions.question: What does 'ਦੋਸਤ' (Dost) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ਦੋਸਤ' means friend in Punjabi. It comes from Persian 'dost' (friend).

questions.question: How do you say 'two' in Punjabi?
What does 'ਦਰੱਖਤ' (Darrakht) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ਦਰੱਖਤ' means tree in Punjabi. It comes from Persian 'darakht'.

questions.question: What does 'ਰਾਤ' (Raat) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ਰਾਤ' means night in Punjabi. 'ਸਵੇਰ' = morning, 'ਸ਼ਾਮ' = evening.

questions.question: What does 'ਕੀ' (Ki) mean in Punjabi?
questions.explanation: 'ਕੀ' means What in Punjabi. Example: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹੈ? = What is your name?

questions.question: What does 'ਦੁੱਧ' (Dudh) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ਦੁੱਧ' means milk in Punjabi. Punjab is known for its dairy farming.

questions.question: Punjabi is written in which script?
questions.explanation: Punjabi is written in Gurmukhi script in India. 'Gur' = Guru, 'mukhi' = from the mouth. The script was standardised by Guru Angad Dev Ji.
